tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Expertise in the Subject Area (Same order can be submitted for multiple criteria if the order meets the respective criteria). Should have provided consultancy services in preparation of Tourism Destination Development/Master Plan/ Detailed Feasibility Study for Tourism sector Infrastructure Projects for Central Government / State Government / Public Sector Undertaking with a minimum estimated capex of 100cr. Each project 5 marks (Maximum 20 marks). Should have provided consultancy services for preparation of Master Plan/ Concept plan for Tourism Sector projects for Central Government / State Government / Public Sector Undertaking with a minimum area of 50 acres. Each project 5 marks (Maximum 10 marks)
